note: Largest USACE campground on Rathbun Lake, nine miles northwest of Centerville: open grassy areas dotted with trees. The northern pads of the F and Y loops look down an open slope to the lake. Boat ramp, dock, marina, playgrounds; swimming beach ~1 mile away. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 187 sites, 50 amp, facilities, reservable, 14-loop rule; fees 25/25->25/28; max 130->101; season May-Sep; 3-night holiday minimum. Lakeview confirmed; no on-water.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview confirmed, 0 on-water candidates. rec.gov site photos show the lake clearly from F09, F10, F11, F12, F14, Y10, Y11, Y12, Y13, Y15 and Y16; M23 and M24 do not. Nearest pads, measured on z17 imagery: Y north arm ~100 m and Y east arm ~100 m from the shoreline, F north arm ~130 m, all across an open grass and brush slope, which is past the ~50 m on-water bound (imagery shows an exposed low-water beach, so at full pool the gap is somewhat shorter; not measured). Pin 40.8350,-92.9175 is ~236 m from the site centroid 40.8365,-92.9155, inside tolerance; rec.gov's own facility point is ~490 m off.

PHONE: rec.gov gives 641-647-2079 for May-September inquiries; stored 641-647-2464 is the closed-season and main office line. Fine to leave; both real.
